**Run SuSiEx Fine-Mapping**
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash

#track start time
START_TIME=$(date)
SECONDS=0
echo "Started at: $START_TIME"

MAX_JOBS=1

process_protein() {
    local OlinkID="$1"
    local chr="$2"
    local left="$3"
    local right="$4"
    local job_num="$5"
    
    echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Starting $OlinkID (chr=$chr, $left-$right)"

    #make sumstats file
    echo "Formatting summary statistics for $OlinkID"
    Rscript ~/susieX/scripts/sumstats_format.R "$OlinkID" "$chr" 2>/dev/null

    #run SuSiEx
    echo "Running SuSiEx for $OlinkID"

    ~/SuSiEx/bin/SuSiEx \
      --sst_file=~/susieX/sumstats/euro_amer/${OlinkID}.sumstats.txt,\
~/susieX/sumstats/afr_amer/${OlinkID}.sumstats.txt,\
~/susieX/sumstats/chn_amer/${OlinkID}.sumstats.txt,\
~/susieX/sumstats/hisp_amer/${OlinkID}.sumstats.txt \
      --n_gwas=1271,675,366,642 \
      --ref_file=~/susieX/plink/euro_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/afr_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/chn_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/hisp_amer \
      --ld_file=~/susieX/plink/euro_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/afr_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/chn_amer,\
~/susieX/plink/hisp_amer \
      --out_dir=~/susieX/output \
      --out_name="$OlinkID" \
      --chr=$chr \
      --bp=$left,$right \
      --chr_col=1,1,1,1 \
      --snp_col=2,2,2,2 \
      --bp_col=3,3,3,3 \
      --a1_col=4,4,4,4 \
      --a2_col=5,5,5,5 \
      --eff_col=6,6,6,6 \
      --se_col=7,7,7,7 \
      --pval_col=8,8,8,8 \
      --maf 0.01 \
      --n_sig=10 \
      --keep-ambig=TRUE \
      --mult-step=TRUE \
      --tol=0.001 \
      --plink=~/SuSiEx/utilities/plink \
      2>&1 | tee ~/susieX/logs/susiex_${OlinkID}.log

    #check exit code
    if [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "$OlinkID: SuSiEx error" >> ~/susieX/failed_proteins.log
        tail -n 10 ~/susieX/logs/susiex_${OlinkID}.log >> ~/susieX/failed_proteins.log
    fi

    #clean up temporary log
    rm -f ~/susieX/logs/susiex_${OlinkID}.log
    
    #clean up plink files
    rm -f ~/susieX/plink/*.ld.bin
    rm -f ~/susieX/plink/*frq.frq
    rm -f ~/susieX/plink/*ref.bim

    echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Finished $OlinkID"
}

export -f process_protein

#parallel processing of jobs
tail -n +2 ~/susieX/cis_windows_round2.txt | \
parallel -j "$MAX_JOBS" --colsep '\t' --env process_protein --line-buffer \
    'process_protein {1} {2} {3} {4} {#}'

#track end time
END_TIME=$(date)
echo "Started:  $START_TIME"
echo "Finished: $END_TIME"
echo "Total runtime: $SECONDS seconds"

#track errors
if [ -f ~/susieX/failed_proteins_round2.log ]; then
    FAILED_COUNT=$(wc -l < ~/susieX/failed_proteins_round2.log)
    echo "Failed proteins: $FAILED_COUNT (see ~/susieX/failed_proteins_round2.log)"
else
    echo "All proteins completed successfully!"
fi
```

**Summary Statistics Formatting within Wrapper**
```{python}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(tidyr)
})

#arguments
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
protein <- args[1]
chr <- args[2]
pops <- c("euro_amer", "afr_amer", "chn_amer", "hisp_amer")

for (pop in pops) {
  qtl_file <- paste0("~/qtl_mapping/", pop, "/tensorqtl/nominal/nominalchr", chr, "cis_qtls.gz")
  qtl_table <- fread(qtl_file)
  protein_table <- qtl_table %>% 
    filter(phenotype_id == protein) %>% 
    separate(variant_id, into = c("chr", "bp", "ref", "alt"), sep = ":", remove=F) %>%
    select(chr, variant_id, bp, ref, alt, slope, slope_se, pval_nominal)
  protein_table$chr <- gsub("chr", "", protein_table$chr)
  protein_table$chr <- gsub("X", "23", protein_table$chr)
  colnames(protein_table) <- c("chr","snp","bp","A1","A2","beta","se","p")
  individual_file <- paste0("~/susieX/sumstats/", pop, "/", protein, ".sumstats.txt")
  write.table(protein_table, individual_file, col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
}
```

**Combine files**
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

#susieX files from the directory structure
base_dir <- "~/susieX/output"
files <- list.files(base_dir, 
                    pattern = ".*\\.cs$", 
                    full.names = TRUE,
                    recursive = TRUE)

print(paste("Found", length(files), "files"))
if(length(files) == 0) {
  print("No files found! Check if the directory path and pattern are correct.")
  quit()
}

#read first file to establish expected structure
first_file <- fread(files[1])
expected_cols <- colnames(first_file)
expected_ncols <- ncol(first_file)
print(paste("Expected structure:", expected_ncols, "columns"))
print(paste("Expected columns:", paste(expected_cols, collapse = ", ")))

#initialize list and counters
data_list <- list()
good_files <- 0
problem_oids <- c()

#check each file
for(i in 1:length(files)) {
  file_path <- files[i]
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  
  #extract OID from filename 
  OlinkID <- regmatches(file_name, regexpr("OID\\d+", file_name))
  if(length(OlinkID) == 0) {
    OlinkID <- "Unknown"
  }
  
  #read the data file
  tryCatch({
    data <- fread(file_path)
    
    #check if structure matches expected
    if(ncol(data) != expected_ncols) {
      problem_oids <- c(problem_oids, OlinkID)
      next
    }
    
    #add OlinkID identifier and store
    data$OlinkID <- OlinkID
    data_list[[length(data_list) + 1]] <- data
    good_files <- good_files + 1
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    problem_oids <<- c(problem_oids, OlinkID)
    print(paste("Error reading file:", file_name, "-", e$message))
  })
  
  if(i %% 100 == 0) print(paste("Checked", i, "files"))
}

print(paste("Good files:", good_files))
print(paste("Problem files:", length(problem_oids)))
if(length(problem_oids) > 0) {
  print("All problem OIDs:")
  print(problem_oids)
}

#merge
merged_data <- rbindlist(data_list)

#edit
merged_data_formatted <- merged_data %>% select(OlinkID, SNP, CS_ID, CS_PIP)
colnames(merged_data_formatted) <- c("phenotype_id", "SNP", "susieX_CS", "susieX_PIP")
  
#save to the parent directory
output_file <- "~/susieX/cis_finemap.tsv"
fwrite(merged_data_formatted, output_file, sep = "\t")

#print summary statistics
print(paste("Total rows in merged data:", nrow(merged_data)))
print(paste("Unique OIDs processed:", length(unique(merged_data$OlinkID))))

#add to comparisons
finemap_results <- fread("~/compare_susie/meta_cis_tensor_vs_susier_vs_sushie_vs_multi.tsv")

combined_results <- full_join(finemap_results, merged_data_formatted, by=c("phenotype_id", "SNP"))

#ensure no duplicates (only 1 OID/SNP pair OID21343 19:12821455:G:A)
combined_results <- combined_results %>% 
  filter(!is.na(SNP)) %>%
  distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE)

results_ordered <- combined_results %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, everything()) 

write.table(results_ordered, "~/compare_susie/meta_cis_tensor_vs_susier_vs_sushie_vs_multi_vs_susiex.tsv", row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```
